Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.view.freemarker.console

Class ChartCardType

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.view.freemarker.console.ChartCardType
All Implemented Interfaces:
CardTypeHandler
public final class ChartCardType extends Object implements CardTypeHandler
The built-in chart card type: a JSON5 body naming a helper, a legacy flat kind, or a raw ECharts option, with data from exactly one of src=, an inline data array or a source (data: topic). juneau-charts.js renders it with ECharts. The kinds are fixed: line, bar, donut, heatmap, scatter, pie and treemap.

The one bus role is data (a source card's data:<key> subscription), and the ops are the eight chart commands (highlight, downplay, showTip, hideTip, zoomTo, legendSelect, export and refresh), so Java's E-44 agrees with the client's E-JS-47. The checks:

  • helper (an object with a kind) and a legacy kind are mutually exclusive, and one of helper, kind or option is required;
  • option and patch are JSON objects, and decorators, on and every $fn marker name must be valid extension names (E-74);
  • renderer is canvas or svg, maps values are same-origin paths and partialFrames needs a source;
  • every line/bar/scatter series needs a field, a donut or pie needs string label and value fields, a heatmap needs x, y and a string value, a treemap needs groupBy and a string label (with an optional string size, a color key and tileFields);
  • height must be at least ChartDef.MIN_HEIGHT, and onClick.href must be a same-origin path (SafePathTemplate.isSameOriginPath(String)), the same checks ChartDef makes;
  • onClick holds an href or an action, never both. The action (also each topicActions[] entry, whose topic must be one on publishes, and each actions[] catalog entry, which must be present: "dialog") needs a unique id, a same-origin endpoint (and form), a POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE method, a string or false confirm, no present but dialog and no onSuccess: "navigate".
Example:

<@card type="chart" id="orders-trend" title="Orders" src="/console/store/stats/daily"> { kind: 'line', x: { field: 'day' }, series: [ { field: 'placed', label: 'Placed' } ] } </@card>

Since:
10.0.0
